## Relationships

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gracie--paul-irving.md)

Gracie and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) share a romantic connection, with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) actively courting her by Volume 2. Their evolving relationship is a frequent topic of conversation among local mothers as Anne's teaching term comes to an end. Though their interactions involve surrounding community gossip, the two maintain an established courtship during this time.
